tasks.design: Configure citation styles and actual source identifiers in {REFERENCE_MANAGER}. Research, evidence interpretation and manuscript writing remain full work. evidence.claim: Model knowledge: citation managers format references from actual source metadata; configuration and coverage must be verified.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Count only residual formatting after the existing reference manager; its runtime earns no new saving.

tasks.design: First enable the existing {LMS} to {STUDENT_REGISTRY} connector. If no connector exists, map an exact validated import to remove actual second-system rekeying. Actual attendance capture, grade decisions, complete transfer checking and the separate final-version commit remain human work. This is record transfer, with no automated grade decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same actual student results may require rekeying into a second registry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native connectors or deterministic student-id and course-id imports.
tasks.still_hard: Actual attendance, authorized grade provenance and exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Resolving a result that belongs to the wrong student or assessment.
tasks.altitude: Remove verified second-system rekeying while retaining result authority.

evidence.claim: The digest documents a university requirement to also publish learning-system grades in its student registry; it establishes a possible double-entry boundary, not this institution’s baseline.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, conditional on actual residual rekeying to a distinct registry. Existing connector or same-system save gives zero incremental benefit; inspect native configuration first.

s1 counts actual attendance and verified grade capture in full. Its outputs include student_id, course_id, assessment_id, approved_grade, attendance_date and actual_status. s2 matches exact identifiers and reports rejects; s3 checks every grade and destination, with missing or ambiguous rows entered manually.

Grade-setting labour is unchanged and never inferred from a model. The complete final import precedes approval; changed rows or destination void approval. Commit stays full effort; share 1 is schema granularity rather than measured click cost.
